name: Funeral Assistance (ANBOCWWB)
benefit: 1. Under the scheme, an amount of ₹5,000/- may be given to the nominees/dependents of deceased registered workers, towards funeral expenses.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a legal nominee or dependent of the deceased worker.
   1. The deceased worker should have been a resident of the Union Territory of Andaman &amp; Nicobar Islands.
   1. The deceased worker should have been engaged in any building or other construction work.
   1. The deceased worker should have been registered under the Andaman &amp; Nicobar Islands Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
   1. The deceased worker should have had an active membership with the Board.
